check_number.description: Remittance/warrant identifier for this payment block. LABEL ALIASES: MS ENVISION 'REMITTANCE' (on the RA banner); CA Medi-Cal RAD 'WARRANT NO'/'WARRANT NO.'. Extract verbatim incl leading zeros. Do NOT confuse with claim_number (TCN/CCN) or provider number.

check_amount.description: Total dollar amount of this remittance/warrant if printed as a single check/warrant total; else null. Numeric, no $ or commas.

ra_date.description: Date printed on the remittance advice header. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'DATE'; CA 'DATE'. Format MM/DD/YY or MM/DD/YYYY as printed. Do NOT confuse with a claim's DATES OF SERVICE.

payer_name.description: Primary payer/program name in the RA header. MS: 'MISSISSIPPI ENVISION MMIS' (use this system name, not the 'DIVISION OF MEDICAID' line). CA: 'CA MEDI-CAL'. Verbatim.

payee_name.description: Name of the provider/facility receiving payment. MS: the SERVICE PROVIDER NAME / provider on the banner. CA: the 'TO:' provider name (e.g. 'ABC PROVIDER','CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL'). Do NOT put the provider NUMBER here.

payee_provider_number.description: Provider number of the payee. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'PROVIDER NO'; CA 'PROVIDER NUMBER'. Digits, verbatim. Do NOT confuse with payee_npi.

payee_npi.description: National Provider Identifier of the payee if printed (MS 'NPI NUMBER', 10 digits); else null. Do NOT confuse with payee_provider_number.

claim_type.description: Claim/section type label printed in the header if present. CA 'CLAIM TYPE' (e.g. 'OUTPATIENT','INPATIENT','LONG TERM CARE','MCARE CROSSOVER'); MS provider-type banner (e.g. 'INPATIENT','VISION AND HEARING'). Else null.

claim_number.description: Unique payer claim control number for this adjudicated claim. LABEL ALIASES: MS ENVISION 'TCN' (Transaction Control Number, ~17 digits); CA Medi-Cal RAD 'CLAIM CONTROL NUMBER'/'CCN' (~13 digits). Extract verbatim incl leading zeros. Do NOT confuse with patient_account_number or recipient_id.

patient_name.description: Patient/recipient name as printed (typically LAST FIRST [MIDDLE]). LABEL ALIASES: MS 'BENEFICIARY NAME'; CA 'RECIPIENT NAME'. Verbatim as one string.

recipient_id.description: Member/recipient Medicaid identifier. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'MEDICAID ID'; CA 'RECIPIENT MEDI-CAL ID NO.'. Verbatim. Do NOT confuse with claim_number or patient_account_number.

patient_account_number.description: Provider's internal patient account/control number. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'PAT ACCT NUM'; CA 'PATIENT CONTROL NUMBER'. This is the PROVIDER's number, NOT the payer claim control number. Null if absent.

medical_record_number.description: Medical record number for the claim if printed (MS 'MED REC NO'; CA 'MEDICAL RECORD NUMBER'); else null.

claim_from_date.description: First date of service for the claim. LABEL: 'DATES OF SERVICE' (from). Format MM/DD/YY[YY] or MMDDYY as printed. Null if absent. Transcribe EXACTLY as printed — do NOT add or remove slashes. The CA RAD service-date columns are headed literally 'MMDDYY' (six bare digits, no slashes); MS ENVISION prints slashed dates.

claim_to_date.description: Last date of service for the claim ('DATES OF SERVICE' to). Same format. Null if absent. Transcribe EXACTLY as printed — do NOT add or remove slashes. The CA RAD service-date columns are headed literally 'MMDDYY' (six bare digits, no slashes); MS ENVISION prints slashed dates.

total_submitted.description: Total billed/submitted amount for the whole claim. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'SUBMITTED AMT'; CA claim 'TOTAL CHARGES'/'BILLED AMOUNT' total. Numeric. Null if not printed.

total_paid.description: Total paid amount for the whole claim. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'TOT PAID AMT'; CA 'PAID AMOUNT' total. Numeric. Null if blank.

total_patient_responsibility.description: Total patient responsibility for the claim. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'PAT RESP AMT'; CA patient liability 'PAT LIAB'/share-of-cost. Numeric. Null if absent.

claim_status.description: Adjudication status of the claim. MS: explicit 'STATUS' column ('PAID'/'DENY'). CA: the SECTION the claim sits under ('APPROVES','DENIES','SUSPENDS','ADJUSTMENTS'). Verbatim/uppercase. Null if indeterminable.

reason_codes.description: Claim-level denial/adjustment reason code(s) if printed at the claim row (CA 'RAD CODE'; MS claim-level 'EXCEPTION CODES'). State-specific 4-digit codes, space-separated if multiple, verbatim. Null if codes are only at the service line.

claim_number.description: The parent claim's control number (TCN/CCN) that THIS service/charge line belongs to. Must equal the claim_number of its claim. Used to group lines under claims.

line_number.description: Line item number within the claim if printed (MS 'LINE' = 1,2,3...). CA RAD charge rows usually have no explicit line number -> null.

date_of_service_from.description: Service line from-date. 'DATES OF SERVICE' on the line. MM/DD/YY[YY] or MMDDYY verbatim. Null if absent. Transcribe EXACTLY as printed — do NOT add or remove slashes. The CA RAD service-date columns are headed literally 'MMDDYY' (six bare digits, no slashes); MS ENVISION prints slashed dates.

date_of_service_to.description: Service line to-date. Null if absent or same single date. Transcribe EXACTLY as printed — do NOT add or remove slashes. The CA RAD service-date columns are headed literally 'MMDDYY' (six bare digits, no slashes); MS ENVISION prints slashed dates.

procedure_code.description: Procedure/service code on the line. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'PROC'; CA 'PROC CODE'/'PROCED CODE'; institutional CA 'ACCOM CODE' (accommodation/revenue). Core code only, verbatim. Null if absent.

modifiers.description: Procedure modifier(s) if present (MS 'M1 M2 M3 M4'; CA 'PROCED CODE MODIFIER'). Join multiple with a space. Null if none.

revenue_code.description: Revenue code if printed (MS 'REVCD'). Null if absent.

units.description: Units/quantity for the line. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'LINE UNITS'; CA 'QTY'/'DAYS OR VISIT'. Numeric. Null if absent.

charge_amount.description: Billed/charge amount for the line. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'LN SUBM AMOUNT'; CA 'TOTAL CHARGES'/'BILLED AMOUNT' (row). Numeric. Null if absent.

allowed_amount.description: Allowed/payable amount for the line. LABEL ALIASES: CA 'PAYABLE CHARGES'/'ALLOWED AMOUNT'/'MEDI-CAL ALLOWED'. MS RA may not print a separate allowed -> null.

paid_amount.description: Paid amount for the line. LABEL ALIASES: MS 'LN PAID AMOUNT'; CA 'PAID AMOUNT' (row). Numeric. Null if blank.

line_status.description: Line adjudication status if printed (MS 'LN STATUS' = 'PAID'/'DENY'). Null if absent.

reason_codes.description: Service-line denial/adjustment/exception reason code(s). LABEL ALIASES: MS 'EXCEPTION CODES' (4-digit, e.g. '0132 0439'); CA 'RAD CODE' (4-digit, e.g. '0401'). State-specific reason codes, NOT national CARC/RARC. Space-separated if multiple, verbatim. Null if none.

payments.description: All remittance/warrant payment header blocks in the document (one per REMITTANCE/WARRANT NO).

claims.description: Every adjudicated claim shown in the document, keyed by TCN(MS)/CCN(CA). Do not drop or merge claim rows.

service_lines.description: Every service/charge line across all claims, each carrying its parent claim_number. Do not drop lines.
